capacity_usable_kwh.notes: InsideEVs: smaller EX60 packs are 80 and 91 kWh usable (P12 117 gross / 112 usable); KBB/Motor1 give 80 kWh for this US trim.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs says "high-nickel battery chemistry" (Sunwoda cells for the 80 and 91 kWh packs; CATL for 112), which is the NMC family; no page says NMC for the smaller packs.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Volvo EX90 support article (search excerpt; volvocars.com 403) describes navigation-triggered preconditioning and a manual start in the charging view; the same article id exists on the EX60 support site (not opened). Value follows that basis.

dc_max_kw.notes: The Charge Port (relaying Volvo): P6 peaks at 320 kW. Motor1 lists 350 kW.
